zones.title: Booking gate
zones.body: Rules in order: a booking already exists; the slot was not offered in this call; the caller has not confirmed it (state CONFIRM with this slotId read back). Only Proceed books.

zones.title: Book
zones.body: Idempotency key session:slot. The confirmation code comes from DealerBook, never from the model.

panels.title: AR-13 BookAppointment
panels.body: BookingGate is the only place a booking can start: the slot must be one offered in this call, read back in CONFIRM, and confirmed in a later turn. Books with an idempotency key, writes bookingRef and confirmationCode to the session, sets state BOOKED. The spoken confirmation is built from this result, never from the model.
